title: Placement: Majority Element II (Boyer-Moore N/3)
description: Given an integer array `nums` of size `n`, find all elements that appear more than floor(n / 3) times. Return sorted list of distinct elements.
constraints:
1 <= len(nums) <= 5 * 10^4
• Time: O(N) | Space: O(1) auxiliary
explanation: At most two elements can exceed n//3 occurrences. Counting frequencies verifies candidates in O(N) time.
